title: kbid.py add's stale-lock clear can take a live holder's lock, so two adds hold the sources lock at once after a crash
goal: _clear_stale in _tools/kbid.py never moves aside a lock a live writer made after the waiter judged the old one stale, a lock a third writer creates before os.link restores the old one survives, and a failed link is not swallowed, so concurrent adds after a crashed writer's stale lock neither drop a row nor tear the .tmp; _sources_lock removes the lock it created when os.fdopen or the write of its owner line raises; and .gitignore lists _sources.csv.lock and _sources.csv.lock.clear.*

run: import sys,os,tempfile;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import kbid;d=tempfile.mkdtemp();lock=os.path.join(d,'s.lock');open(lock,'w').write('C');o=os.link;os.link=lambda a,b:(open(b,'w').write('D'),o(a,b))[1];kbid._clear_stale(lock);os.link=o;t=open(lock).read();print('lock now held by',t);sys.exit(1 if t!='C' else 0)

import sys,os,tempfile;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import kbid;d=tempfile.mkdtemp();p=os.path.join(d,'_sources.csv');f=os.fdopen;os.fdopen=lambda *a,**k:(_ for _ in ()).throw(OSError('planted'));exec('try:\n with kbid._sources_lock(p,p): pass\nexcept OSError: pass');os.fdopen=f;left=os.path.exists(p+'.lock');print('lock left:',left);sys.exit(1 if left else 0)

clauses.clause: _clear_stale in _tools/kbid.py never moves aside a lock a live writer made after the waiter judged the old one stale, a lock a third writer creates before os.link restores the old one survives
a failed link is not swallowed, so concurrent adds after a crashed writer's stale lock neither drop a row nor tear the .tmp
_sources_lock removes the lock it created when os.fdopen or the write of its owner line raises
